notes: The pi-stop plugs directly onto the GPIO header (no breadboard or jumper wires), on physical pins 9 (GND), 11 (GPIO17), 13 (GPIO27), 15 (GPIO22) per the diagram.
The pi-stop is a new part type with ports R, A, G, GND; each LED is modelled as passing R/A/G to GND (resistors are built into the board).
The GND pin at physical pin 9 is assumed to be named GND.2 in the raspberry-pi catalogue entry (GND.1 = pin 6).
The manual also lists an alternative of 3 discrete LEDs with resistors; the diagram uses the pi-stop, so that is what was modelled.
Colour-to-pin mapping per the manual: Red=GPIO22, Amber=GPIO27, Green=GPIO17.
